examples.label: Product hero with badge, dual call-to-action and a trust row
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-jumbotron" site="Global" id="hero-ferrymark-inbox">
<.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" size="small" rounded="full" icon="hero-sparkles" class="mb-6"> Shared drafts landed in the January release <.component component_name="chelekom-h1" site="Global" font_weight="font-bold" class="tracking-tight sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl"> One inbox for every customer email your team owns <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-2xl opacity-70"> Ferrymark puts support, sales and billing mail in one place, shows you who is already typing, and stops two people answering the same customer twice.
<.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/signup" variant="default" color="primary"> Create a workspace <.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/product/tour" icon="hero-play-circle"> Watch a two minute tour
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-check-circle" class="size-4" /> Free for two seats <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-check-circle" class="size-4" /> Imports from Gmail in a minute <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-check-circle" class="size-4" /> Leave whenever you like

examples.label: Split hero over the page background with a detail panel
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-jumbotron" site="Global" id="hero-kestrel-roastery" variant="transparent">
<.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" font_weight="font-semibold" class="uppercase tracking-[0.2em] opacity-60"> Wholesale roasting since 2009 <.component component_name="chelekom-h1" site="Global" font_weight="font-bold" class="mt-4 leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-5xl"> Coffee your café can pour the same way every morning <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-6 max-w-xl opacity-70"> Kestrel roasts to order on Tuesdays and Fridays, delivers across the county in its own van, and dials in your grinder on site before the first invoice goes out.
<.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/samples" variant="default" color="dark"> Request a sample box <.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/contact" variant="outline" color="natural" icon="hero-arrow-up-right"> Talk to a roaster
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-calendar-days" class="size-5 shrink-0 opacity-70" />
Roasted Tuesday, with you Thursday
Nothing sits in a warehouse waiting for an order.
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-truck" class="size-5 shrink-0 opacity-70" />
Free delivery over twenty kilos
Our own driver, so a late order is a phone call rather than a ticket.
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-wrench-screwdriver" class="size-5 shrink-0 opacity-70" />
Grinder calibration included
We come back whenever the beans or the weather change.
